Name: Berry Booster Juice
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=4]Drinking this buffs the "speed" and "Foraging" by +3 each.
The buff lasts for one day.[/size][/color]

[size=3]You will receive "4" each in the mail on the first day of the spring and fall berry period.[/size]

[size=2]Because they are so powerful, the recipes themselves are limited in availability only in the final stages of the game.
Also, the ingredients used to make them are strictly limited so that they cannot be used on a regular basis.
This recipe is set up to fill the collection and not to make it an item that can be used regularly.[/size]

English and Japanese are supported.

[color=#00ff00][size=5]Recipe Release Requirements.[/size][/color][size=2]
[/size][spoiler]
Linus friendship level is 10.
Leo friendship level is 10.
Already watched the event of Leo's friendship level 9.
If you meet all of these criteria, you will receive an mail with the recipe attached.

[/spoiler]
